'''Logan Erstar''' was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and the former [[Baron of Filby]]. Erstar found himself at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] in the company of [[Gillian Rayburst]] and [[Candor 6612]].<ref name="Game" />
